title: Quote native coverage audit
scope: Q01-Q06 only; 14 direct Quote controls plus the planned Advanced/Visibility behavior in Q05.
coverage_policy: A row is evidenced only where the named setting is represented by exact native DOM or computed-style proof after the relevant save/reload path. This is bounded representative coverage, not an exhaustive value or runtime-control claim.

computed_assertions: Alignment flex-end maps to align-self flex-end; the alignment record covers flex-start, center, and flex-end.
cases.reload_devices: DOM proof recorded at 1280, 834, and 414px after preview/reload.

dom_assertions: empty Attribution yields bare BLOCKQUOTE with zero captions at all three widths
unsafe javascript: source yields no cite, no links, and plain caption text
cases.reload_devices: Empty attribution and unsafe URL records include Desktop, Tablet, and Mobile; unsafe source remains inert after reload.

dom_assertions: figure is the measured Quote wrapper; rendered text remains inside the Quote DOM.
computed_assertions: Desktop/Tablet: Georgia, 26px, 41.6px line height, max-width 542.572px, text-align center
Mobile: Georgia, 20px, 32px line height, max-width 417.363px, text-align center
all devices: 5px solid rgb(180, 95, 60) rule and padding 12px 18px 14px 20px
cases.reload_devices: Computed proof includes 1280, 834, and 414px records after style/reload.

dom_assertions: no horizontal overflow recorded in the responsive override proof.
computed_assertions: reset proof: all three devices inherit 24px/34.8px/500.836px
padding matches the authored four-side values before and after reset
cases.reload_devices: Distinct Desktop, Tablet, and Mobile values and post-reset values are recorded after reload.

cases.purpose: Advanced identity/layout, visibility, and conditional output
dom_assertions: id quote-proof, classes qa-quote pull-quote, and custom outline are present
hide rules retain DOM and use display:none at the selected breakpoint
condition equals match produces one Quote; non-match produces zero Quote/captions
computed_assertions: relative position, top 4px, z-index 2, visible overflow, and max-width 530.297px recorded.
cases.reload_devices: Visibility matrix records all three breakpoint selections; condition records include all three devices for has-value/equality cases.
limits: Condition source/operator/value controls are behaviorally evidenced but the candidate81 native record predates candidate82 accessible-label fix.
Visibility uses display:none with DOM retained; do not interpret as DOM omission.

dom_assertions: lead/body class token changes are present while Quote content and attribution markup remain intact.
computed_assertions: lead/body computed font, size, line-height, color, border, and padding are recorded; detached state retains appearance exactly.
cases.reload_devices: Lead/detached proof covers 1280, 834, and 414px; body proof covers all three widths.
limits: Representative named styles only; not every runtime text-style option.

unverified_or_pending: candidate82 native verification of enhanced combobox labels
arbitrary values, all fonts, all named styles, all motion/hover/focus states, and all runtime-generated controls

scope_gaps: No exhaustive enumeration of arbitrary unit values, palette values, fonts, named text styles, or custom CSS expressions.
Generic Motion/State/Hover/Focus controls are outside Q01-Q06 proof scope.
The Q05 condition label/source combobox accessibility fix is pending candidate82 native verification.
No claim is made for Breadcrumb or Icon coverage in this Quote-only artifact.
